bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 200 日均线

read.en: ASML rose 1.2% on Oct 26 to $1,590.90, trading between $1,583.04 and $1,612. It is just above the rising 200-day average ($1,590.0), and below the falling 5-day ($1,606.2), 10-day ($1,634.5), 30-day ($1,713.7) and 100-day ($1,746.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,749.01), and RSI is 38.

The close edged back above the 200-day ($1,590.0); the $1,612 high stalled under the 5-day. Resistance is $1,606–1,614 (5-day, Oct 26 high, Oct 20 low), then $1,634.5 (10-day) and $1,641–1,657 (Oct 14–19 closes). Support is $1,583–1,590 (Oct 26 low, 200-day), then $1,550 (Oct 23 low) and $1,530.6 (Jul 29 low). A close above $1,614 would target $1,635–1,657; a close below $1,583 would open $1,550.
